periods.occupation: professional magic knight; temporary academy helper/commentator

appearance.overview: Very small adult woman in an oversized kimono and red haori.

attire.default: white kimono with cherry blossoms and red haori

personality.summary: Irreverent, lustful and playful, but an exceptionally sharp judge of combat talent.

habits.daily_routine: Helps Hagun when Kurono is short of staff.
quirks: flirts with Ikki before his match

formative_events: Became KOK top-league fighter and Olympic representative
background.pre_story: Comes to Hagun to help Kurono and observe Ikki.

abilities_owned: elite body-movement technique; specific Device not shown in vol-01

relationships.shinguji-kurono: Professional contemporary and friend who restrains her misconduct.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Object of evaluation; she praises his courage and insight.
relationships.student-council: Speaks with them after Ikki's victory.

periods.summary: Nene appears as a famous pro and temporary commentator. She teases Ikki before his match, analyzes his victory over Kirihara as not seeing through Hunter's Forest but seeing through Kirihara himself, leaves commentary once satisfied, and tells the student council Ikki may become a key challenger in the selection battles.

key_events.summary: Commentates and identifies the nature of Ikki's Perfect Vision victory.
Discusses Ikki's potential with Hagun student council members after the match.

periods.label: 夜叉姬的观战

status.current: observes key matches and recognizes Ikki's abnormal growth

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Notices he understands Nuk足 and later acknowledges him as beyond expectation.
relationships.torajiro-nango: Her revered but embarrassingly denied teacher.

periods.summary: Nene appears with Kurono during Shizuku and Toka's match, demonstrates and explains Nuk足 by suddenly appearing at Stella and jokingly groping her. During the final match she watches with Kurono and Nango, sees that Ikki compresses Ittou Shura beyond ordinary human limits, and calls him an unbelievable man. Her presence links Toka's martial style to Nango's lineage.

key_events.summary: Explains Nuk足 and Nango's connection to Toka.
Observes Ikki's Ittou Rasetsu and reacts to its extremity.

periods.time: Akatsuki crisis and final week before Seven Stars
periods.label: 夜叉姬赶到并收下史黛菈

status.current: protects Stella and agrees to give her a brutal week of training
status.profile_note: Kagami's wall newspaper describes her gravity ability and forbidden Hadou Tensei

personality.summary: Crude, powerful and teacherly in her own way; willing to indulge a desperate student's struggle without easy instruction.
personality.teaching_style: shows power and hits hard rather than explaining, forcing Stella to find her own breakthrough

relationships.stella-vermillion: Accepts Stella's request for special training after seeing her desperation.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Clashes briefly with his Kusanagi while saving Stella's group.
relationships.shinguji-kurono: Runs with Kurono from Osaka toward Tokyo; both sense Edelweiss's sword aura.

periods.summary: Nene's wall-newspaper profile explains that her gravity ability can call down space debris with the forbidden Hadou Tensei, one of the most destructive Noble Arts known. During the Akatsuki crisis she and Kurono rush back from Osaka by running along the Shinkansen route after flights stop, then both sense Edelweiss's overwhelming sword aura. Nene reaches the mountain road in time to protect the unconscious Stella and the Hagure sisters, trading attacks with Ouma and forcing Reisen to withdraw Akatsuki. Afterward Stella asks Nene for help; Nene agrees only to a week of merciless training in which she will not teach, only beat Stella until she finds her own answer.

key_events.summary: Kagami's profile records her gravity ability and forbidden technique.
Arrives in time to protect Stella's escape group and prompt Akatsuki's withdrawal.
Accepts Stella's request for brutal special training.

periods.time: Okutama training camp shortly before Seven Stars
periods.label: 夜叉姬的不给答案特训
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy temporary instructor; professional knight circuit

status.role: trains Stella after Stella's defeat by Ouma

personality.summary: Brutal, playful and deliberately withholding; she forces Stella to discover her missing element herself.

relationships.stella-vermillion: Trainee whom she outmaneuvers and refuses to spoon-feed answers.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Stella's prior defeat by him motivates the training.

periods.summary: Nene appears in the sleepless-night episode as Stella's special trainer. She evades Stella through forest and lake terrain for half a day, casually destroys Dragon Fang with gravity-enhanced kicks, and defeats Stella without using her Device. She tells Stella that her sword has a decisive flaw but refuses to explain it, making self-discovery a condition of the training. The next morning she mistakenly interprets Stella's sleeplessness as serious reflection on that flaw.

key_events.summary: Defeats Stella in training and tells her to identify the flaw in her sword herself.

periods.time: Stella training flashback through Amane hospital scene
periods.label: 逼出巨龙并监督厄运的夜叉姬
titles: 七星剑武祭准决赛解说员

status.current: recognizes Stella's awakened true power and later secures Amane's promise not to meddle in the final

personality.summary: Playful and mischievous, but as a teacher she is ruthless enough to risk terrifying a student into awakening the power they need.

relationships.stella-vermillion: Student during special training; Nene attacks seriously to make Stella rediscover pride and awaken Dragon Spirit.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Commentates his Amane fight and trusts him to subdue Amane's rampage after he volunteers.
relationships.amane-shinomiya: Hospital visitor; promises to speak for reduced punishment if he swears not to interfere in the final.
relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: Former teacher/political figure whose motives and ability she questions after Akatsuki collapses.

periods.summary: In flashback, Nene tells Stella that her sword has a decisive flaw: she is too humble for her own absolute talent. On the eve of Seven Stars she attacks Stella seriously, uses gravity to crush and corner her, and forces Stella to awaken Dragon Spirit by remembering pride in her own destiny. As semifinal commentator she explains Stella's true concept-interference ability and also diagnoses Amane's causality: first as accidental luck, then as a visible black-hand concentration of death results. She almost intervenes in Amane's rampage but accepts Ikki's responsibility while remaining ready. In hospital she relays Kiriko's message to Amane, warns him not to interfere in the final, and then questions Tsukikage about how he knew Amane's past and what his own Blazer ability may be.

key_events.summary: Forces Stella to awaken her true Dragon concept.
Explains Stella's awakened power as commentator.
Identifies the death hands and orders shields before Ikki subdues Amane.
Visits Amane and secures his promise not to interfere with the final.
